title: 02 RTE V1 validation stub: NPS 4 Class 150 RF flanged valves with their operator envelopes (stemHeight = valve centre to the top of the operator along the stem; handwheelDiameter / handwheelThickness = a disc centred at stemHeight; gearbox and actuator = a cylinder whose top is at stemHeight). Face-to-face lengths are the B16.10 values of the stub; every operator dimension is a declared input. Not a standard; no value is verified.

provenance.citation: 02 RTE V1 declared INPUT (stub, not from a standard, unverified): gate valve NPS 4 Class 150: handwheel disc 400 mm at 650 mm above the pipe centre, 30 mm thick
